Bananarama - True Confessions (Obsessions of Your Mind and Rarities) Deluxe 16bit / 44.1kHz

Exclusive - the ‘Obsessions of Your Mind and Rarities’ digital edition of True Confessions.

Featuring the original album, plus the studio B-sides, a selection of 1986 remixes and the 2026 edits.

Also features ’Do Not Disturb (Bananamix)’, the 1985 Bananarama Megamix.
